title: Night vision: matching a thermal camera to the map
summary: What a thermal camera sees and why a night frame is not a dark photo; an audit of a night dataset; NCC template matching and where it fails; footprint, coverage and preparing a frame; the motion gate — then you make your own training pairs from the map, train a small 4-point homography network with PyTorch, measure it against NCC in five conditions, and sabotage it the way LOC-6 did.
